_meta.purpose: On-road price and running cost of a new private car by fuel, for the car cost tool (js/car.js, engine/car.js).
_meta.slabs: Road tax slabs are [up_to_ex_showroom_inclusive, percent]; null means no upper limit. 'same_as' points a fuel at another fuel's slabs.
_meta.caution: State road-tax rules change in budgets and by notification, and published summaries disagree. Every city carries a confidence note and its sources; the tool shows the rate it applied and lets the buyer replace it with the figure on the dealer's quote.
_meta.not_covered: Kolkata (West Bengal): published rates conflict (5.5% to 10%, EV status unclear); left out until confirmed. Second cars, company-owned cars and BH-series registration are taxed differently and are not modelled.

fees.note: Registration (₹600), smart-card RC (₹200), high-security plates and FASTag, rounded. Dealer 'handling' or 'logistics' charges are not a government fee and are left out.

insurance.note: Comprehensive cover with the mandatory 3-year third-party for a new car, as a share of the ex-showroom price; a rough average across compact cars. Renewals fall as the car ages; 2% a year is a middle figure.

tcs.note: Tax collected at source of 1% on a car above ₹10 lakh. Paid at purchase and claimed back against your income tax for the year, so it is cash out, not a cost.

defaults.efficiency_note: Real-world figures for a compact car or SUV in city and highway use, below the official (ARAI) claims. Strong hybrids (Toyota, Maruti self-charging) only; a mild hybrid is closer to petrol.
defaults.maintenance_note: Scheduled service and wear parts in the first five years; tyres, accidents and battery replacement are not included.
defaults.public_charging_note: Share of charging done at public DC fast chargers, which cost about ₹18-25 a kWh against ₹5-8 at home.

cities.label: Delhi
cities.electricity_note: Delhi's EV charging tariff on a separate meter
cities.confidence: high for petrol and diesel; medium for EVs (Delhi EV Policy 2026-30 exemption reported, price cap unclear)
cities.notes: Diesel cars older than 10 years cannot be driven in Delhi NCR (15 for petrol).

cities.label: Mumbai
cities.confidence: medium: a further 1% on petrol, diesel, CNG and hybrid cars was reported from July 2025 and is not included; the proposed 6% on EVs above ₹30 lakh was withdrawn
cities.notes: EVs exempt under the Maharashtra EV Policy to March 2030.

cities.label: Bengaluru
cities.confidence: high for petrol and diesel; medium for EVs (lifetime tax on electric cars from April 2026, cess treatment unconfirmed)
cities.notes: An 11% cess is charged on the road tax. Electric cars lost their full exemption in April 2026.

cities.label: Chennai
cities.confidence: high: life-tax slabs as amended by the Tamil Nadu Motor Vehicles Taxation Act amendment; EV exemption to December 2027

cities.label: Hyderabad
cities.confidence: medium: first-car life-tax slabs (G.O.Ms.No.53, 2025); a ₹5,000 road safety cess from March 2026 is reported by one source; EV exemption to 31 December 2026
cities.notes: A second car in the same name pays more. The EV exemption is due to end on 31 December 2026.

cities.label: Ahmedabad
cities.confidence: medium: 6% for all cars; the 1% EV concession ended on 31 March 2026
cities.notes: Gujarat charges the tax on the price before GST, so 6% of the ex-showroom price slightly overstates it.

sources: State transport and finance department notifications as summarised by: mycarhelpline.com, motomotar.com, carthings.in, spinny.com, cars24.com, bankbazaar.com, newsmeter.in (Telangana G.O.Ms.No.53), cartoq.com and deccanherald.com (Maharashtra EV tax), evautoindia.co.in (Karnataka EV tax), meraev.com (Delhi, Gujarat EV policy); checked 28 October 2026.

Fuel prices: city retail prices reported 26-28 October 2026 (hdfcsky.com, newsable.asianetnews.com, kalingatv.com; Pune and Ahmedabad from cmv360.com, mypetrolprice.com, fuelpricetoday.in). Revised daily by the oil companies.
Home charging tariffs: DISCOM EV and domestic tariffs as summarised by pulseenergy.io, procharge.in and bharatrevolt.com.
